_about: Item 29 standards board: one list of every Claude-side and Muse-side item and whether it is up to standard. Hand-kept; tools/build-standards-board.js turns it into board.html and adds what the Graphify code map knows about each item's files. Status is one of: up, needs-work, blocked, parked, not-built. Update an item's status in the same commit as the work that changes it.
